current_selected_flat_record.title: Convergence of Spectral Estimators for Diffusion Tensors
current_selected_flat_record.statement:
Let $(
u_k,u_k)$ be noisy observations of eigenpairs and let $\mu$ be an invariant density satisfying $$\operatorname{div}(S
abla u_k)=
u_k\mu u_k$$ with Neumann boundary conditions. Prove convergence of the spectral reconstruction estimator obtained by fitting these equations to recover the matrix-valued coefficient $S$.
